title: APP.md frontmatter (agentapp/v1 — AIP draft)
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter portion of an agentapp/v1 APP.md manifest. Fields derived from the reference defineApp surface. Fields marked 'draft' in the AIP (config, state, verify) are optional until promoted.

id.description: Machine identifier for the app (distinct from its agents' ids). Optional; setting it makes the app discoverable.

agents.description: AIP-42 agent refs. Required unless a ui block is present — an app with neither agents nor ui is rejected by defineApp.

attach.description: Other AIP doctype handles carried with the app (AIP-40).

workspace.description: AIP-34 workspace id; emit writes a root WORKSPACE.md.

requires.description: APP ids this app depends on.

path.description: UI HTML file; emit copies it to .agentproto/ui/index.html.

tools.description: The ui.tools allowlist — the only daemon tools the UI may call via window.McpApp.

port.description: Preferred local port for `agentproto app serve`. A hint; falls back to auto-assignment.

artifact.description: Persistent HTML dashboard; emit copies it to .agentproto/artifact/index.html.

skill.description: Cowork skill directory; emit copies it to .agentproto/skill/.

artifacts.description: Artifact types this app's agents may produce, declared for discovery.

dev.description: Dev-launch configuration for running the app locally.

data.description: Default data directory hint for the app_data_* plane (relative to the app dir).

externalReadRoots.description: Host directories granted READ-ONLY access outside the app dir. Validated to exist at install time; there is no write path.

config.description: draft — human-edited YAML config files, validated against an emitted JSON Schema.

state.description: draft — the daemon-owned append-only event ledger.

ledger.description: Path of the append-only JSONL ledger (default data/state/events.jsonl).

verify.description: draft — the single truth: one command composing every check.

manifestRef.description: An {id, path} ref to a bundled AGENT.md or WORKFLOW.md, relative to the app dir.

allOf.description: An app with neither agents nor a ui block has nothing to do — defineApp rejects it.
